\[
\cos\theta = \sqrt{\frac{\sum_{k \in S} (F_k \star I)^2}{\sum_{k=1}^{9} (F_k \star I)^2}},
\qquad
S = \{1,2,3,4\} \text{ or } \{5,6,7,8\}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(F_k\): The nine orthonormal masks
- \(S\): The edge or the line subspace

The nine Frei-Chen masks are an orthonormal basis of 3x3 windows: four span edges, four span lines and one is the mean. The squared projections add up to the energy of the window. The ratio of the edge or line energy to the total is the squared cosine of the angle between the window and that subspace. The output is 255 times the cosine, so a pure edge or line gives 255.
